verdict.rationale: The only guarantee Numeral documents covers on-time filing: it will pay penalties and interest if a filing is late. It does not cover the accuracy of the tax calculations it produces, and calling the returned amount 'accurate' is marketing copy, not a commitment. Handling state tax mail is a related service, not a documented audit-support commitment for calculation errors, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As a finance lead, the vendor stands behind its numbers — a documented accuracy guarantee or audit support commitment if a calculation it produced turns out wrong

citations.quote: Your sales tax will be filed on time, or we'll pay your penalties and interest charges.
